datasets.name: ALSU (original cohort - RPL GWAS)
datasets.path_note: root_path is the raw GenomeStudio export (24,258 files, 61GB - confirmed by direct audit) and correctly has no PLINK output; processed_path holds the real QC/imputation pipeline output. This is NOT stale/superseded data - per the project's own source-of-truth doc (COHORT_EXPANSION_2026_08_INTEGRATION_NOTES.md in the ALSU-analysis repo), this original 1,074/1,047-sample cohort is DELIBERATELY kept separate and used exclusively for the RPL (recurrent pregnancy loss) GWAS (Step 16), by explicit user decision, while a separate expanded cohort (see 'alsu_expanded') is used for population-genetics analyses. Two valid current datasets for two different purposes, not one dataset with a stale and a current version.

datasets.name: ALSU (expanded cohort - population genetics)
datasets.n_claimed_note: Per COHORT_EXPANSION_2026_08_INTEGRATION_NOTES.md: combined raw merge of ALSU original (1,247) + 48redone (48) + GWAS2026 wave 1 / gwas96 (95) + GWAS2026-2 (95) = 1,485 raw samples, QC'd down to 1,268 final (mind 0.20 -> 1,384; IBD dedup -> 1,326; het/KING -> 1,268). Popgen re-analysis (Steps 7-15) uses 1,256 of these post-imputation. Explicitly scoped to population-structure analyses only (PCA/ADMIXTURE/Fst/PBS/relatedness) - the RPL GWAS (Step 16) deliberately excludes this expansion and stays on the original 'alsu' cohort.

datasets.name: Cardio - Cases / Controls / Transplant
datasets.n_claimed_note: CORRECTED from the original catalog's claimed n=65, which has no basis found anywhere on disk. Real count is 25, confirmed three independent ways: (a) VCF files on disk - 13 in results/ (Cardio1-12 plus the transplant sample Cardio1017, excluding CardioUndetermined which is the demultiplexer's unassigned-reads bucket, not a sample) plus 12 in healthy/results/; (b) distinct sample IDs in annotations/cases.tsv (12: Cardio1-case..Cardio12-case) and annotations/controls.tsv (12), plus the transplant sample tracked separately in annotations_transplant/; (c) annotations/aggregated_pathogenic_variants.json reports case_count:12/control_count:12 consistently across every variant. NOTE: an earlier version of this note said 'cases.tsv=12, controls.tsv=12' in a way that implied those files have 12 lines - they do not. They are variant annotation tables (196 and 206 lines respectively) whose first column is the sample ID; 12 is the number of DISTINCT sample IDs in each, not the line count. The total of 25 was always right; that particular justification was stated without being run, and is corrected here.
datasets.sub_paths_note: cases/controls counted from these two dirs only (transplant and annotations dirs deliberately excluded from counting - transplant is 1 known sample already reflected in n_claimed, and annotations/ describes the SAME 25 samples rather than being a new batch, so scanning it too would double-count). Known caveat not yet resolved: results/ physically contains 14 sample outputs (Cardio1-12 + Cardio1017 transplant + CardioUndetermined demux leftover) rather than exactly the 12 true cases - a correct count requires filtering by annotations/cases.tsv's authoritative sample list, which this scanner does not yet do. Other real output dirs not yet counted: results_pangenome_cases/, healthy/results_pangenome_controls/ (pangenome-reference reruns of the same samples), transplant/, annotations_transplant/.
datasets.description: WGS DRAGEN germline pipeline (native single-sample naming CardioN.*, NOT the sarek/bcftools convention used by cardio_wes_v350432671). 12 cases + 12 controls + 1 transplant sample = 25 total, each with full DRAGEN output (BAM, hard-filtered VCF, coverage/QC metrics, ROH) and most also reprocessed against a pangenome reference. Pathogenic-variant aggregation exists and is real (annotations/aggregated_pathogenic_variants.json), covering the 12+12 case/control set; transplant sample annotated separately, not yet merged into the aggregation.

datasets.name: GWAS 2026 wave 1 - IDAT batch
datasets.n_claimed_note: CORRECTED from 96 (raw IDAT batch size) to 83 - the real post-variant-QC count at this batch's own final stage (gwas2026_varqc: geno/hwe/maf filtering applied, confirmed via direct .fam count). Of the original 96, 95 were successfully genotype-called (DRAGEN Array, May 2026, per COHORT_EXPANSION_2026_08_INTEGRATION_NOTES.md) and 83 remain after variant QC. Note this batch has NOT been through the same full sample-level QC (relatedness/heterozygosity/missingness) as gwas2026_2 - no qc/ side-files found, unlike gwas2026_2 - so 83 reflects variant-level filtering only, not a fully finished sample-QC'd cohort.

datasets.identity_note: These are rescans of original ALSU cohort members whose chips catastrophically failed. Independently confirmed (verify_remaining.sh): all 48/48 rescan48 sample IDs appear in ALSU's PRE-imputation fileset (winter2025/PLINK_301125_0312/ConvSK_raw, 1,247 samples), and 0/48 in ALSU's POST-imputation fileset (1,074 samples). That zero is the expected signature rather than a problem: these are exactly the samples QC dropped (1,247 -> 1,074) because their chips failed, which is why they were rescanned in the first place. 47 of the 48 then survive alsu_expanded's joint QC. So a cross-dataset sample view will correctly show rescan48 overlapping alsu_expanded but NOT alsu.
datasets.description: 48 samples, 2x24 GSA chips - rescans of ALSU original-cohort members whose original chips failed. Not a new/independent cohort; its downstream product is the merged 'alsu_expanded' dataset.
